نتحذلق (form IIq)
# نَتَحَذْلَقُ (nataḥaḏlaqu) /na.ta.ħað.la.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَذْلَقَ (taḥaḏlaqa)
# نَتَحَذْلَقَ (nataḥaḏlaqa) /na.ta.ħað.la.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَذْلَقَ (taḥaḏlaqa)
# نَتَحَذْلَقْ (nataḥaḏlaq) /na.ta.ħað.laq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَذْلَقَ (taḥaḏlaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
